Besides the Target Combo, {{clr|L|5LP}} has little use due to its poor frame data. }} =====5MP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Standing Medium Punch | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 5MP
{{Modern_sf6}} A[M] | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|marisa_5mp|imageHeight=180px|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|marisa_5mp|imageHeight=180px|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_5mp}} * 2f extra recovery on whiff * Puts airborne opponents into {{sf6-jug|limited juggle}} state * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 16f (TC) A fairly quick mid-range button that chains into one of her most important Target Combos. At only {{sf6-adv|M|-1}} with low pushback, opponents expecting the TC follow-up can be conditioned to block her staggered {{clr|M|5MP}} pressure. Because it knocks down airborne opponents, the {{clr|M|5MP}}~{{clr|M|MP}} TC will juggle opponents trying to jump out of Marisa's pressure. }} =====5HP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Standing Heavy Punch | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 5HP (HOLD OK)

An approaching downward hook, useful for whiff punishing and {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} pressure. Not cancelable, but has a notable follow-up like her other standing punches; it can also be charged for significant advantage on hit and block. {{clr|H|Charged 5HP}} is your biggest {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}} starter, becoming {{sf6-adv|VP|+15}} on {{clr|PC|PC}}. Be ready to let this rip any time the opponent uses a particularly unsafe move, like a reversal or {{clr|SA|Super}}. It also improves the {{clr|H|5HP}}~{{clr|H|HP}} TC follow-up, making it a true blockstring with extra range and frame advantage, allowing Marisa to shred the opponent's Drive gauge if they don't parry it. }} =====5LK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Standing Light Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 5LK
{{Modern_sf6}} -- | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|marisa_5lk|imageHeight=180px|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|marisa_5lk|imageHeight=180px|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_5lk}} * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 15f ** Special/{{clr|DR|DI}} cancel is delayed until after 2nd recovery frame ({{clr|DR|DR}}: 3rd recovery frame) * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|P|+2}} oH / {{sf6-adv|E|0}} oB * Applies 20% damage scaling to next hit when beginning a combo (100/80/70...) A quick shin kick and Marisa's farthest reaching light normal. Extremely limited follow-up options, generally only comboing into {{clr|L|214LP}} or {{clr|SA|SA2}}, though at closer ranges it cancels into {{clr|OD|214PP}} as a 6-frame {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}} starter. Useful as a low-commitment neutral check, particularly against {{clr|DR|Drive Impact}} when buffering ({{clr|DR|DR}}/{{clr|DR|DI}}/Gladius). After mashing a defensive {{clr|L|2LP}} when Marisa is too far for another chained jab, a {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}} link into {{clr|L|5LK}} can reach for a conversion. Despite not hitting low, {{clr|L|5LK}} will disrupt upper-body armored moves like Gladius and Scutum. }} =====5MK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Standing Medium Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 5MK
{{Modern_sf6}} 5M | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|marisa_5mk|imageHeight=190px|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|marisa_5mk|imageHeight=180px|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_5mk}} An important normal out of {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}}. {{clr|M|5MK}} generates the most frame advantage of any non-charged normal for Marisa. At {{sf6-adv|VP|+8}} on hit, it can link into {{clr|M|2MP}} or (if close) {{clr|H|4HP}}. You can also use {{clr|M|5MK}} as a low-risk meaty button on opponent's wakeup. It is easy to hit confirm, and at {{sf6-adv|VP|+4}} links into {{clr|L|2LP}}, which combos into {{clr|L|LP Dimachaerus}} ({{clr|L|214LP}}). A decent neutral poke, though it rarely creates follow-up pressure. At range, you cannot convert off {{sf6-adv|VP|+4}} and {{clr|M|5MK}} cannot be special canceled. }} =====5HK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Standing Heavy Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 5HK (HOLD OK)

A slow, long-range roundhouse kick that moves Marisa forward, with even more range on the charged version. This move is most important for its {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}} properties, launching the opponent high into the air for an easy confirm into a high damage juggle. At 15 frames, {{clr|H|5HK}} is too slow to whiff punish many moves on reaction, but it is a high-damage whiff punish against any move with a long recovery. }}

Can be buffered into {{clr|L|214LP}} for a combo conversion, but has few other useful cancel routes unless benefiting from {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} or {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}} bonus advantage. }} =====2MP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Crouching Medium Punch | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 2MP
{{Modern_sf6}} 2M | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=140px|marisa_2mp|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=150px|marisa_2mp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_2mp}} * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 15f * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VP|+12}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VP|+7}} oB * Topmost hurtbox on frames 8-15 is projectile invincible to avoid High Tiger Shot Very nice range for a cancelable crouching poke. Standing in range to land {{clr|M|2MP}} is ideal for Marisa, as she has powerful conversions with {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} or her special moves. This is Marisa's only normal that doesn't move or extend her hurtbox forward before it's active. }} =====2HP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Crouching Heavy Punch | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 2HP (HOLD OK)
{{Modern_sf6}} 2H (HOLD OK) | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=180px|marisa_2hp|caption=}} ---- {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=200px|marisa_2hp_hold|caption=Held Version}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=140px|marisa_2hp|caption=}} ---- {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=140px|marisa_2hp_hold|caption=Held Version}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_2hp}} * '''Anti-Air Invuln (Head):''' 10-13f (cannot hit cross-up) * Can hold button 17f for improved properties * Only first 2 active frames hit grounded; active frames 3-5 only hit airborne * Puts opponent into {{sf6-jug|limited juggle}} state on hit; much higher launch vs. airborne opponents * {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}}: KD +54 ({{sf6-jug|limited juggle}} state) {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_2hp_hold}} * '''Anti-Air Invuln (Head):''' 20-31f (cannot hit cross-up) * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 20f (Super) * Releasing the button on frames 5-16 results in uncharged version with 4f startup * Only first 2 active frames hit grounded; active frames 3-6 only hit airborne * Puts opponent into {{sf6-jug|limited juggle}} state on hit * {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}}: KD +61 ({{sf6-jug|free juggle}} state) A high uppercut. Your primary anti-air normal. Somewhat slow, so use it sooner than later and be sure not to hold the button as the attack may charge and force you to mistime this. Its anti-air hitbox improves massively on the 3rd active frame to catch farther ranged jump-ins. {{clr|H|Charged 2HP}} is primarily combo filler, as it leaves the opponent in juggle state. While charging can lead to big damage if it hits an aerial opponent, whiffing leaves you wide-open to an easy punish, so it's not recommended unless you have a huge read on an opponent's jump habits. As a punish starter, both versions launch the opponent high into the air. Marisa can implement several charged normals or Target Combos afterwards, or even cancel into a fully charged {{clr|SA|SA1}} for some incredible damage. }} =====2LK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Crouching Light Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 2LK
{{Modern_sf6}} A[L] | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|marisa_2lk|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|marisa_2lk|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_2lk}} * Chains into {{clr|L|2LP}}/{{clr|L|2LK}} * Applies 20% damage scaling to next hit when beginning a combo (100/80/70...) Your only conventional low combo starter, but a good one at least. Generally used to combo into {{clr|L|2LP}} > {{clr|L|214LP}} for a quick confirm. It doesn't gain much as a starter from {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} unless you also score a {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}}, after which you can link into a stronger button like {{clr|M|5MP}}, {{clr|M|2MP}}, or {{clr|H|4HP}}. }} =====2MK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Crouching Medium Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 2MK
{{Modern_sf6}} -- | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|marisa_2mk|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|marisa_2mk|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_2mk}} * Applies 20% damage scaling to next hit when beginning a combo (100/80/70...) * Topmost head hurtbox on frames 9-16 is projectile invincible to avoid High Tiger Shot (becomes vulnerable on frame 17~) Your go to low poke with good range and hitbox priority, important for checking the opponent at mid-range and preventing them from freely walking back out of Marisa's pressure. It can link into {{clr|L|2LP}} at point blank or after a single blocked {{clr|DR|DR~}}{{clr|L|2LP}} or {{clr|DR|DR~}}{{clr|L|2LK}}. Unlike most {{clr|M|2MKs}}, this cannot be special canceled. It's {{sf6-adv|VP|+9}} on hit when used out of {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}}, allowing for a conversion depending on range (from closest to farthest): * {{clr|H|4HP}} > {{clr|H|214HP}} * {{clr|M|5MP}}~{{clr|M|MP}} * {{clr|M|2MP}} (inconsistent cancel ranges, use {{clr|L|236LK}} / {{clr|OD|236PP}} / {{clr|SA|Supers}}) * {{clr|M|6MP}} (into ~{{clr|H|HK}} vs. standing, ~{{clr|H|HP}} vs. crouching) The {{clr|M|6MP}} combo is by far the most reliable, as it's hard for Marisa to consistently get close enough for {{clr|H|4HP}} when starting from midrange. There is a high likelihood that the opponent will be standing if they get hit, so the {{clr|M|6MP}}~{{clr|H|HK}} Target Combo into {{clr|SA|Super}} will usually work for solid damage. }} =====2HK===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Crouching Heavy Kick | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 2HK (HOLD OK)
{{Modern_sf6}} 3H (HOLD OK) | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|marisa_2hk|caption=}} ---- {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=180px|marisa_2hk_hold|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|marisa_2hk|caption=}} ---- {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=180px|marisa_2hk_hold|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_2hk}} * {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}}: HKD +44 * Has juggle potential * Can hold button for 20f to improve properties * Topmost hurtbox on frames 1-7 is projectile invincible to avoid High Tiger Shot {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_2hk_hold}} * {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}}: HKD +50 * 3f extra recovery on whiff * Has juggle potential; keeps opponent in a {{sf6-jug|limited juggle}} state when juggled into * Releasing the button on frames 7-15 results in an uncharged {{clr|H|2HK}} with 4f additional startup * Topmost hurtbox on frames 1-7 is projectile invincible to avoid High Tiger Shot (becomes vulnerable on frame 8~) A sweep that moves Marisa forward, giving it decent range but also ensuring she will be more punishable if blocked. A bit on the slower side, so it cannot punish some of the safer sweeps in the game from characters like like Cammy, Chun-Li, E. Honda, and Kimberly. The fully charged version is much slower, making it more susceptible to Perfect Parry or {{clr|DR|Drive Impact}} in exchange for safety on block and additional range. After a midscreen {{clr|H|214HP}}~{{clr|H|6P}}, a {{clr|H|Charged 2HK}} juggle lets Marisa chase the opponent down with point blank {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} oki into manually timed follow-ups like Throw, {{clr|M|2MK}} (low), {{clr|H|3HP}} (overhead), or charged {{clr|H|Heavy}} normals for block pressure and Drive damage. In the corner, this pops the opponent high enough to juggle into {{clr|SA|SA2}} instead. }}

== Command Normals == =====6MP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Novacula 1 | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 6MP
{{Modern_sf6}} 6M | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=160px|marisa_6mp|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=180px|marisa_6mp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_6mp}} * Forces stand on {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}} * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 20f (TC) The forward movement during startup makes this Marisa's farthest reaching medium poke. Useful for landing {{clr|PC|Counter-hits}} against the opponent's light buffers, allowing a consistent link into {{clr|L|2LP}}. When used as an approach out of {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}}, Marisa gets slight advantage and block and a light extension on hit, though her reward on a {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}} here is much more damaging with a link to {{clr|H|4HP}}. {{clr|M|6MP}} is Marisa's best combo option out of a {{clr|DR|DR~}}{{clr|M|2MK}} approach, as the poor momentum causes most other 7 or 8-frame attacks to whiff at its most common range. If the opponent is in Burnout, Marisa can approach with {{clr|M|6MP}} to become {{sf6-adv|P|+1 on Block}}. Her mixup game is not particularly strong; the only true frame trap is {{clr|L|2LP}}, which only leads to {{clr|L|5LK}} > {{clr|L|214LP}} on {{clr|PC|Counter-hit}}. Walking back avoids all mixups while only risking a single {{clr|L|2LK}}/{{clr|M|2MK}} with no possible combo extension. If close enough, Marisa can use this approach to start chipping with {{clr|L|2LP}} > Gladius, which can outspace or armor through many reversal 4-frame buttons, depending on screen position and how long the button is held. Can be hitconfirmed into one of two follow-up Target Combos depending on whether the opponent is standing or crouching. Crouching opponents must be hit with {{clr|M|6MP}}~{{clr|H|HP}} for a simple knockdown, while standing characters can be hit with the {{clr|SA|Super}}-cancelable {{clr|M|6MP}}~{{clr|H|HK}}. This ender can be guaranteed with a {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}} starter, as it forces the opponent to stand; this is very effective as a punish against whiffed normals or blocked sweeps. }} =====4HP===== {{MoveDataCargo | title = Magna Bunker | subtitle = | input = {{Classic_sf6}} 4HP
{{Modern_sf6}} 4H | images = {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=190px|marisa_4hp|caption=}} ---- {{MoveDataCargoImage|imageHeight=200px|marisa_4hp_hold|caption=}} | hitboxes = {{MoveDataCargoImage|hitbox=yes|imageHeight=180px|marisa_4hp|caption=}} | info = {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_4hp}} * 3f extra recovery on whiff * Can hold button 17f for improved properties * Causes air reset when juggled into (except from {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}}) * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 20f ** Special/{{clr|DR|DR}}/{{clr|DR|DI}} cancel is delayed until after 2nd recovery frame * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VP|+13}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VP|+9}} oB {{AttackDataCargo-SF6/Query|marisa_4hp_hold}} * 5f extra recovery on whiff * Releasing the button on frames 5-16 results in uncharged version with 3f startup * Puts airborne opponents into {{sf6-jug|limited juggle}} state * Does not gain additional advantage when timed as a meaty * '''Cancel Hitconfirm Window:''' 20f * '''{{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel advantage:''' {{sf6-adv|VP|+23}} oH / {{sf6-adv|VP|+14}} oB Lead uppercut. Marisa's most important normal for combos, leading into important special moves like {{clr|H|214HP}} for huge, meter-efficient damage. Requires a {{clr|PC|Punish Counter}} or {{clr|DR|Drive Rush}} cancel to link into this move.
